bodies: National Board on Fire Service Professional Qualifications
International Association of Fire Fighters / IAFC
Illinois Law Enforcement Training and Standards Board

exams.name: Wildland Fire Behavior S-190
exams.blurb: The NWCG course covering wildland fire behavior, weather and fuels needed alongside S-130 for entry-level wildland qualification.

exams.name: Wildland Firefighter Training S-130
exams.blurb: The NWCG field skills course teaching wildland firefighting tactics, safety and hand-tool use for initial attack crews.

exams.name: Wildland Firefighter Type 1
exams.blurb: An advanced NWCG wildland qualification for firefighters who lead squads and perform complex suppression assignments.

exams.name: Wildland Firefighter Type 2
exams.blurb: The entry-level NWCG wildland firefighter qualification for crew members performing basic suppression and holding tasks.

exams.name: Wildland Incident Commander Type 5
exams.blurb: The NWCG single-resource incident commander qualification for managing small initial-attack wildland fire incidents.

exams.name: Wildland Red Card Work Capacity Test
exams.blurb: The arduous fitness test required for a wildland firefighting Red Card, typically a three-mile hike carrying 45 pounds in 45 minutes.

exams.name: SPeD Industrial Security Officer Certification
exams.blurb: A DCSA certification for industrial security officers overseeing facility clearances and contractor security compliance.

exams.name: SPeD Program Security Certification
exams.blurb: A DCSA certification for program security officers managing classified programs and special access requirements.

exams.name: SPeD Security Fundamentals Professional Certification
exams.blurb: The entry-level DCSA security certification validating knowledge of the national industrial security program and personnel security.

exams.name: SPeD Special Access Program Professional Certification
exams.blurb: A DCSA certification for professionals administering special access programs and their heightened control requirements.

exams.name: NTN Corrections Exam
exams.blurb: A National Testing Network entry exam for correctional officer candidates assessing judgment, reading and report-writing skills.

exams.name: NTN Dispatch / ECOMM Exam
exams.blurb: A National Testing Network entry exam for 911 dispatchers measuring multitasking, memory, map reading and customer service aptitude.

exams.name: NTN FrontLine National Exam
exams.blurb: A video-based police entry exam from the National Testing Network measuring situational judgment, reading and writing for member agencies.

exams.name: Emergency Fire Dispatch
exams.blurb: A certification for dispatchers who use the MPFD protocols to classify fire incidents and coordinate appropriate response levels.

exams.name: Emergency Medical Dispatch
exams.blurb: A certification for dispatchers who use the MPDS protocols to triage medical calls and give pre-arrival instructions to callers.

exams.name: Emergency Police Dispatch
exams.blurb: A certification for dispatchers who use the MPPD protocols to prioritize police calls and guide officers before arrival.

exams.name: ACA Certified Correctional Executive
exams.blurb: An ACA credential for senior correctional leaders confirming executive-level mastery of policy, finance and agency administration.

exams.name: ACA Certified Correctional Manager
exams.blurb: An ACA credential for correctional managers demonstrating leadership, operations and staff development competence.

exams.name: ACA Certified Correctional Officer
exams.blurb: An ACA credential validating the knowledge and skills of line correctional officers in institutional security and inmate supervision.

exams.name: Certified Protection Professional
exams.blurb: ASIS’s senior security management credential covering physical, personnel and intellectual property protection for experienced practitioners.

exams.name: Physical Security Professional
exams.blurb: An ASIS credential for specialists in physical security assessments, design and the integration of protective measures and technology.

exams.name: Professional Certified Investigator
exams.blurb: An ASIS credential for investigators demonstrating skill in case management, evidence handling and surveillance techniques.

exams.name: IFSAC Firefighter I
exams.blurb: An accredited certification confirming a firefighter meets NFPA 1001 Firefighter I performance and knowledge job standards.

exams.name: IFSAC Firefighter II
exams.blurb: An accredited advanced certification confirming mastery of NFPA 1001 Firefighter II incident and fireground leadership competencies.

exams.name: Pro Board Firefighter I
exams.body: National Board on Fire Service Professional Qualifications
exams.blurb: A Pro Board accredited Firefighter I credential aligned with NFPA 1001 for structural firefighting minimum job performance requirements.

exams.name: Pro Board Firefighter II
exams.body: National Board on Fire Service Professional Qualifications
exams.blurb: A Pro Board accredited Firefighter II credential confirming advanced NFPA 1001 structural firefighting and incident command knowledge.

exams.name: Law Enforcement Physical Ability Test
exams.blurb: A job-task physical test for police candidates covering running, push-ups, sit-ups and an obstacle or pursuit course simulation.

exams.name: Police Pre-Employment Polygraph and PHQ
exams.blurb: The background questionnaire and polygraph screening stage verifying an applicant’s honesty, history and suitability for police service.

exams.name: Associate Emergency Manager
exams.blurb: An entry-level IAEM credential for emerging emergency managers who have not yet met the experience threshold for the CEM.

exams.name: Certified Emergency Manager
exams.blurb: The premier emergency management credential requiring education, experience, training and a written exam on the profession’s principles.

exams.name: Certified Protection Officer
exams.blurb: A foundational security officer credential covering patrol, emergency response, report writing and customer service in protection roles.

exams.name: Certified Security Supervisor
exams.blurb: A mid-level security credential for front-line supervisors covering leadership, scheduling and on-site security operations management.

exams.name: Candidate Physical Ability Test
exams.body: International Association of Fire Fighters / IAFC
exams.blurb: The standard timed firefighter physical test of eight job-simulated events including hose drag, ladder raise and stair climb with gear.

exams.name: National Firefighter Selection Inventory
exams.blurb: A behavioral inventory assessing the work styles and interpersonal traits associated with effective firefighter performance.

exams.name: Criminal Justice Basic Abilities Test
exams.blurb: Florida’s entry exam for law enforcement and corrections officers assessing memory, visualization, reasoning and language abilities.

exams.name: Illinois POWER Test
exams.body: Illinois Law Enforcement Training and Standards Board
exams.blurb: Illinois’s physical ability test for police and corrections candidates measuring strength, endurance, speed and agility benchmarks.

exams.name: LAPD Personal Attributes and Behavioral Styles Test
exams.blurb: The LAPD written exam measuring behavioral styles, interpersonal judgment and decision-making for police officer candidates.

exams.name: Municipal Police Officers’ Education and Training Commission Test
exams.blurb: Pennsylvania’s certification exam for municipal police officers covering state law, procedure and the duties of a peace officer.
